sections.normalized_html: Find the quotient and remainder of [MATH: \dfrac{3x^4+7x^3-10x+8}{2-3x}.]
sections.readable_text: Find the quotient and remainder of [MATH: \dfrac{3x^4+7x^3-10x+8}{2-3x}.]

sections.normalized_html: EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
First, we write the divisor in standard form as [MATH: -3x+2.] Then, we factor out the leading coefficient. This gives

[MATH: (3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/(− 3x + 2)|= (3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/(− 3(x − (2)/(3))); = − (1)/(3)((3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/((x − (2)/(3)))).]

Carrying out the synthetic division process on [MATH: \dfrac{3x^4+7x^3-10x+8}{\left(x-\frac23\right)},] remembering to include a coefficient of zero for the [MATH: x^2] term, we arrive at the following:

[MATH: (2)/(3)|3|7|0|− 10|8; 2|6|4|− 4; 3|9|6|− 6|4]

Reading off the bottom row, we get

[MATH: \frac{3x^4+7x^3-10x+8}{\left(x-\frac23\right)} = 3x^3+9x^2+6x-6+\frac{4}{\left(x-\frac23\right)}.]

Finally, we multiply by the original [MATH: -\dfrac 1 3] factor to get

[MATH: (3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/(2 − 3x)|= − (1)/(3)(3x^{3} + 9x^{2} + 6x − 6 + (4)/((x − (2)/(3)))); = − x^{3} − 3x^{2} − 2x + 2 + (4)/(2 − 3x).]

Item 3 — Tutorial: Checking the Division

Dividing [MATH: 2x^3-5x^2-7x+11] by [MATH: x-3,] we obtained that

Item 8 — Example: Dividing a Polynomial by a Linear Binomial With Leading Coefficients

Example Prompt:
Find the quotient and remainder of [MATH: \dfrac{3x^4+7x^3-10x+8}{2-3x}.]

Content:
EXPLANATION

Explanation:
First, we write the divisor in standard form as [MATH: -3x+2.] Then, we factor out the leading coefficient. This gives

[MATH: (3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/(− 3x + 2)|= (3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/(− 3(x − (2)/(3))); = − (1)/(3)((3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/((x − (2)/(3)))).]

Carrying out the synthetic division process on [MATH: \dfrac{3x^4+7x^3-10x+8}{\left(x-\frac23\right)},] remembering to include a coefficient of zero for the [MATH: x^2] term, we arrive at the following:

[MATH: (2)/(3)|3|7|0|− 10|8; 2|6|4|− 4; 3|9|6|− 6|4]

Reading off the bottom row, we get

[MATH: \frac{3x^4+7x^3-10x+8}{\left(x-\frac23\right)} = 3x^3+9x^2+6x-6+\frac{4}{\left(x-\frac23\right)}.]

Finally, we multiply by the original [MATH: -\dfrac 1 3] factor to get

[MATH: (3x^{4} + 7x^{3} − 10x + 8)/(2 − 3x)|= − (1)/(3)(3x^{3} + 9x^{2} + 6x − 6 + (4)/((x − (2)/(3)))); = − x^{3} − 3x^{2} − 2x + 2 + (4)/(2 − 3x).]
